thread:
maria_docs: PR open to migrate audit logs to Structured Audit Events (SAE). I pushed a couple of example snippets and a retention paragraph draft. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987

alex_security: Thanks — I’ll check the compliance wording and the example fields. Quick note: don’t call this "immutable" in docs.

sam_backend: The backend emits under `audit.events.v2`. Minimal example payload:
```
{
  "event_type": "model.inference.request",
  "timestamp": "2026-09-01T12:34:56Z",
  "actor": {"id": "svc-123", "type": "service"},
  "request": {"route": "/v1/generate", "model": "rw-13b"},
  "metadata": {"request_id": "req_abc123", "client_tenant": "tenant-42"}
}
```

maria_docs: Nice — can we trim the payload in docs to the three fields we want users to see? (event_type, timestamp, request.model)

jess_engineering: SDK snippet for JS (ready for inclusion):
```
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-sdk';
const r = new Redwood({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY});
await r.audit.emit({
  event_type: 'model.inference.request',
  timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  request: {model: 'rw-13b'}
});
```

legal_amy: For retention wording: change "we retain audit data for 90 days" to "audit records are retained for a default period of 90 days unless a customer-specific agreement or retention configuration specifies otherwise." Also add a note pointing to the retention config page.

maria_docs: Got it. I'll update the PR with the trimmed example + legal wording and add a short migration section for customers on Dedicated/DedicatedVPC.

alex_security: When you update, ping me. Also add a callout about PII redaction — link to the data-handling guide.

docs-bot: deploy-preview updated: https://deploy.preview.redwood-inference/docs/preview/987 — build passed :white_check_mark:

maria_docs: Thanks everyone — planning to merge after alex_security review. Action items: (1) jess — please confirm snippet tests pass; (2) sam — confirm emitted field names are stable; (3) legal_amy — approve final language. I'll tag reviewers on the PR in 30m.

jess_engineering: I'll run snippet tests now.

sam_backend: Field names are stable, no plans to change.

legal_amy: Approving the language as soon as it's pushed. 

maria_docs: Closing loop: updated PR in place, alex_security left one tiny comment (done), merging in ~15m unless objections.
